angle_name: Lipschitz excursion upgrade: windowed moment hierarchy for the Abel sum, with zero-sum (explicit-formula) attack on the low moments
mechanism: Let T(x) = Σ_{d≤K(x)} μ(d)(π(⌊x/d⌋) − Li(⌊x/d⌋)), K(x) = ⌊x/(y+1)⌋, y = ⌊√x⌋, exactly the Lean primeSieveMoebiusDiscrepancySum. Step 1 (slow-variation lemma, unconditional, elementary): |T(x+h) − T(x)| ≤ C·h + O(√x·exp(−c(log x)^{3/5})) for 0 ≤ h ≤ x, because the π-increments count integers n ∈ (x, x+h] with a prime factor exceeding ~√x (at most 2 representations n = pd each, weight |μ(d)| ≤ 1), the Li-drift is Σ_{d≤K} h/(d log(x/d)) ≤ 2h·log K/log x ≈ h, and terms entering as K(x) grows number ~h/√x, each of size |R(≈√x)| ≪ √x exp(−c(log x)^{3/5}). Step 2 (excursion upgrade): a pinned spike |T(x₀)| = H forces |T| ≥ H/2 on an interval of length ≥ H/(2C), hence H^{2k+1} ≪ ∫_{X/2}^{4X} T^{2k}; so a windowed moment bound ∫_X^{2X} T^{2k} ≪ X^{1+k(1+ε)} yields the pointwise bound T(x) ≪ x^{(k+1)/(2k+1)+ε'} for ALL x — including the deterministic square samples — with k=1 giving exponent 2/3 and k→∞ giving 1/2+ε. This converts the pinned target into an averaged one: RH becomes EQUIVALENT (forward via upgrade + the kernel chain, backward trivially from RH pointwise bounds) to the moment hierarchy "for every ε there is k with ∫_X^{2X} T^{2k} ≪_ε X^{1+k(1+ε)}". Step 3 (attack on low moments, the speculative part): via the truncated explicit formula T(x) ≈ −Σ_{|γ|≤T₀} M_K(ρ) x^ρ/ρ with M_K(s) = Σ_{d≤K} μ(d) d^{−s}, the windowed second moment becomes a discrete zero-sum X·Σ_ρ |M_K(ρ)|² X^{2β_ρ}/|ρ|² with off-diagonal zero pairs damped by 1/|γ−γ'| and Gallagher/Montgomery–Vaughan clustering (fiber size O(log), not linear); unconditional inputs are the Korobov–Vinogradov zero-free region and zero-density estimates, and the μ×R sign interaction survives intact inside |M_K(ρ)|² evaluated at zeros, before any inequality is applied over d. Honest ceiling: k=1 at conjectural strength gives only 2/3 pointwise, and k ≥ 2 off-diagonals need open zero multi-correlation input, so rung 2 is not reachable by this lens alone; the unconditionally deliverable content is the equivalence reformulation plus a PNT-strength rung-0 bound, and I state that plainly rather than claim otherwise.
new_leverage: The declared obstacle list treats "pinned vs averaged" as a wall (exceptional sets may contain x). The new observation is that T has an unconditional O(1) Lipschitz structure — its derivative is the density of integers with a large prime factor minus a matching Li-density, plus exp-small boundary terms — so a pinned spike of height H occupies measure ≳ H and CANNOT sit inside a small exceptional set. Averaged (moment) estimates therefore do transfer to the pinned point at exponent cost (k+1)/(2k+1), degrading to zero cost as k grows. No step in the packet's obstacle audit engages this; it moves the entire problem into the averaged world where Dirichlet-polynomial mean values, discrete moments over zeros, and moment-comparison technology exist, none of which can even be formulated against the pinned statement.
target_estimate: Windowed moment hierarchy for the Abel error: for T(x) = Σ_{d=1}^{⌊x/(y+1)⌋} μ(d)(π(⌊x/d⌋) − Li(⌊x/d⌋)) with y = ⌊√x⌋, prove: for every ε > 0 there exist k ∈ ℕ and C(k,ε) such that for all X ≥ 2, ∫_X^{2X} T(x)^{2k} dx ≤ C(k,ε)·X^{1+k(1+ε)}. Allowed losses: arbitrary constants in k and ε; X^{εk} slack absorbed. Via the upgrade lemma this implies T(x) ≪_ε x^{1/2+ε} for all x, hence the Abel face, hence RH. Single-k versions: k=1 bound X^{2+ε} gives unconditional-in-x pointwise x^{2/3+ε}; k=2 bound X^{3+ε} gives x^{3/5+ε}.

obstacle_positions.F_closure: Exits the class. The only recombination over d happens inside |M_K(rho)|^2 = |Σ μ(d)d^{-rho}|^2 evaluated at complex zeta zeros BEFORE any inequality; no Σ M(d)^2 input with Cauchy-Schwarz/Hölder/triangle over d appears, and the upgrade lemma itself uses no Mertens input at all. The mu x R sign interaction is carried intact into the zero-frequency domain.
obstacle_positions.fiber_growth: Not engaged: no pair-to-modulus transfer in wheel coordinates. Off-diagonal objects are pairs of zeta zeros (rho, rho'); the x-average produces 1/|gamma-gamma'| decay and zero-clustering fibers of size O(log T) (Gallagher), not linear in D.
obstacle_positions.pinned_vs_averaged: This is the obstacle the angle is built to kill, and the position is: it is not a wall but an exponent tax. The unconditional Lipschitz property of T forces any pinned spike of height H to persist on measure >= H/(2C), so averaged 2k-th moment bounds transfer to every pinned x at exponent (k+1)/(2k+1), which tends to the target 1/2 as k grows. Exceptional sets small enough to be invisible to all moments cannot contain a large value of T.
obstacle_positions.modulus_magnitude: Not applicable: no wheel modulus appears anywhere. The frequency space is zeta zeros, with density log T at height T, primorial-free; the vacuous sqrt(full-modulus) gain issue does not arise.
obstacle_positions.parity: Not sieve-only, so the parity wall is not directly engaged: mu enters linearly through the exact Abel identity and then through M_K(s) in the explicit formula, which is analytic rather than sieve-theoretic. Flag: if the moment estimates themselves were later attacked by sieve decompositions of mu, parity would re-enter there.
obstacle_positions.circularity: The reduction direction is fully unconditional: the Lipschitz lemma is elementary, and the explicit formula sums over ALL zeros with no zero-location input. The d=1 term R(x) is never bounded pointwise, only inside window averages. Declared risk: any unconditional pointwise OUTPUT with power saving T << x^{1-delta} would likely imply a zero-free half-plane, so the unconditional deliverable is capped at exp-type savings; I do not claim otherwise.
obstacle_positions.finite_range: The flat 0.35-0.43 cancellation coefficient is consistent with Gaussian-like moment growth but proves nothing (Mertens-deception regime). My numerics are used only to KILL: if empirical normalized moments m_{2k}/m_2^k grow super-Gaussianly, the hierarchy needed for exponent 1/2 is falsified in range. All positive claims are analytic.

kill_test: Two cheap numerical tests at range <= 10^9, both purely negative in force. (a) Lipschitz audit: evaluate T on fine grids in windows around several square samples X_n = (n+1)^2 - 1; measure sup |T(x+h)-T(x)|/h. Prediction: constant C <= ~5, stable across 5 decades. If C grows like a power of x, the excursion upgrade degrades and the angle's core is dead. (b) Moment-growth audit: compute normalized even moments m_{2k} = avg(T^{2k})/avg(T^2)^k for k = 2,3,4,5 over dyadic windows. Gaussian-like growth ((2k-1)!! up to constants) is necessary for the hierarchy that reaches 1/2+eps; clearly super-Gaussian (heavy-tailed) growth kills the path to rung 2 through this angle, leaving at most the 2/3 ceiling from k=1.
rung0_plan: Unconditional, bounded effort, no triangle inequality over d anywhere: (1) prove the slow-variation lemma |T(x+h)-T(x)| <= C h + O(sqrt(x) exp(-c (log x)^{3/5})) with explicit C (elementary counting of n in (x, x+h] with a prime factor > sqrt(x), Li-drift, and K-boundary terms); (2) prove the excursion upgrade H^{2k+1} << integral of T^{2k}; (3) prove the diagonal-dominated second-moment bound int_X^{2X} T^2 dx << X^3 exp(-c(log X)^{3/5}) via the truncated explicit formula, Gallagher zero-clustering, and the Korobov-Vinogradov zero-free region. Combining gives the pointwise PNT-strength bound T(x) << x exp(-c'(log x)^{3/5}) by a route in which the mu-oscillation is never discarded — a rung-0 result with new structure. Steps (1)-(2) are Lean-formalizable against the existing chain at bounded effort.
plausible_partial: Named partial: "Moment-hierarchy equivalence theorem" — RH is equivalent to the windowed moment hierarchy (for every eps there is k with int_X^{2X} T^{2k} << X^{1+k(1+eps)}). Forward direction: slow-variation lemma + excursion upgrade + the existing kernel-verified Abel-face chain; backward direction: RH implies the pointwise Abel bound implies the moments trivially. This is a genuinely new averaged/L^{2k} equivalent of RH, publishable on its own, and formalizable in Lean on top of primeSieveMoebiusDiscrepancySum at bounded effort since the analytic content of the forward direction is elementary real analysis plus classical unconditional facts. Conditional corollary worth stating: the second-moment conjecture int T^2 << X^{2+eps} alone implies T << x^{2/3+eps} for all x, strictly below the empirical triangle scale x^{3/4}.
self_assessed_risk: Honest assessment, stated per instruction: this lens CANNOT reach rung 2 (x^{1/2+eps}) by itself — the moment hierarchy at k >= 2 needs zero multi-correlation inputs that are open, and even the k=1 moment at conjectural strength is quasi-RH-class, so the pinned difficulty is relocated, not removed. The angle above is therefore my strongest defensible adjacent contribution, marked as such: an unconditional, formalizable reduction that structurally defeats the pinned-vs-averaged obstacle plus a rung-0 deliverable. Risk breakdown: low risk on the slow-variation lemma, upgrade lemma, and equivalence theorem (elementary, checkable); moderate risk on the unconditional second-moment diagonal computation (classical but fiddly, K-boundary and truncation errors need care); high risk (UNVERIFIED speculation) on any claim that the averaged moments are materially more tractable than the pinned bound — that is my weakest assumption, stated plainly. All capability claims about the zero-sum attack in Step 3 are unverified.
